rationale: `depends_on` names a SIBLING record in the same file, so it is a real edge and it resolves. Both halves are pinned: `db` resolves to its service path at confidence 1.0, and `absent` stays unresolved with a reason. The resolver reads an index built during the walk; it was a scan of the whole shape index per reference, which is O(refs x symbols) and would not have shown up on a small corpus at all.
